label: Volkswagen

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). Volkswagen OKAPI product-data API (models/configurations) is official; no API for used-car listings on volkswagen.de.

reason: No API for the used-car site. Volkswagen OKAPI product data (https://productdata.volkswagenag.com/swagger-doc.html, rendered 2026-09-25) covers new-vehicle models/configurations behind a sign-up and its Swagger page renders no operations without signing in; it has no VIN decode, listing or valuation operation that fits the automotive vocabulary.
